answer_1.quote: Image captioning, the task of generating text that describes an image, is one of the most fundamental machine learning tasks ...

answer_2.quote: We report standard captioning metrics along with CHAIR and Open-CHAIR over generated captions (beam search decoding with 5 beams). We also provide NLI (p) and BERTScore values.

answer_3.quote: For each detected object, an LLM 4 is prompted to determine whether the object is in the GT caption or not using the prompt: "<s>[INST] An image has the following caption: ... Does the image contain the following object? ... The answer is: [/INST]".
methods: yes/no object presence prompting per detected object

answer_4.quote: We perform a manual evaluation of Open-CHAIR and CHAIR object-level predictions, as described in Section 4. Human annotators check object-level decisions (present or hallucinated) for over 400 random objects.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to judge whether each predicted object is actually present in the image (i.e., a hallucination) or not.
